tasks.prompt: Implement normalize_slug in app.py. It must trim whitespace, lowercase letters, collapse every run of whitespace to one hyphen, and preserve letters and digits. Empty or whitespace-only input returns an empty string. Non-string input must raise TypeError or AttributeError.

Implement positive_total in app.py. It must return the sum of the positive integers in values and ignore zero and negative integers. Empty input returns zero; do not mutate the input. None and non-numeric elements must raise TypeError.
